status: Normative governance criteria; not a deployed evaluator.
fact_semantics: Facts are scope-bound claims established from authenticated evidence. Missing or unverified facts are unknown, not true. A fixture fact is not an operational credential.

facts.common.currentContext: Repository, activity, component, action, subject revisions, adopted governance version, and relevant environment are explicit.
facts.common.referencesVerified: All required referenced revisions resolve to matching exact bytes under separately authorized repository access.
facts.common.authorityVerified: Required decisions were issued by authenticated roles within scope; no applicable withdrawal, revocation, expiry, or unresolved impact hold exists.
facts.common.independenceVerified: Required independent critics and findings dispositions are verified; workers do not self-approve deliverables.
facts.common.upstreamBoundsSatisfied: The action conforms to upstream bounds and adopted Method constraints; any allowable guideline departure has human-owner approval.
facts.baseline.ready: CEO-approved system design and technical requirements, Product Owner business inputs, and role/delegation bounds are available for the affected scope.
facts.sdp.accepted: Management accepted a feasible selected SDP with architecture, activities, dependencies, resource/calendar/cost assumptions, risk, quality work, and commitment bounds recorded.
facts.srs.reviewPassed: The exact service requirements received successful architect review and authorized acceptance, with business ambiguity resolved by the Product Owner.
facts.assignment.current: The PM assignment authorizes this activity, worker, component, phase, and expected output under the selected plan.
facts.exploration.bounded: The exploration assignment states questions, permitted experiments, constraints, and the return-to-designer boundary; no full design or production readiness is claimed.
facts.design.reviewPassed: The exact detailed design and contracts received Solution Architect review and acceptance before handoff, with Test Architect input.
facts.approach.resolved: The developer consulted the Application Architect about every discovered design refinement; changed upstream inputs have their required decisions.
facts.construction.handoffComplete: Requirements, detailed design, proxy/technical constraints, allowed dependencies, and applicable decisions are part of the handoff.
facts.stp.reviewPassed: The exact service test plan received Application Architect and independent test critique and Test Architect approval.
facts.construction.submitted: The assigned implementation and white-box test client are complete for review and identify their exact source and design revisions.
facts.code.reviewPassed: Application Architect and independent Test Agent critics completed successful review; leading-architect acceptance covers the submitted revision.
facts.integration.actual: The exact reviewed component revisions are integrated with the required real dependencies and the integrated snapshot and environment are recorded.
facts.integration.accepted: The Solution Architect accepted technical integration for that snapshot; no changed baseline or commitment is hidden in this acceptance.
facts.verification.actual: The required STP cases passed against the integrated snapshot, with Test Architect acceptance and applicable regression/real-service evidence.
facts.phase.criteriaSatisfied: The criterion for this particular phase is satisfied by valid, current reviews or tests; no incomplete phase is credited.
facts.phase.weightApproved: The phase-weighting basis is consistently selected and the credit matches the completed phase, not time, tokens, or commits.
facts.delivery.projectTestsSatisfied: The selected project/milestone requires and has passed its system, subsystem, component, interaction, regression, smoke, and real-dependency tests as applicable.
facts.delivery.businessAccepted: The Product Owner accepted required business behavior against the agreed evidence for this milestone.
facts.change.assessed: A recorded impact assessment identifies affected scope, upstream/downstream dependencies, evidence, project consequences, and unresolved questions.
facts.change.decided: Every affected authority domain has its required decision; SA/PM project consequences and CEO/human-owner commitment acceptance are resolved where applicable.
facts.change.revalidated: Required reviews, tests, new approvals, or authorized no-impact reaffirmations cover the revised subject and bound inputs.
facts.assignment.released: The PM assignment has been rechecked and authorizes the affected work to resume under the accepted revised inputs.

gates.title: Front-end baseline readiness
authorized_next_actions: Design the project within the agreed business and architecture bounds.
gates.failure_or_missing_evidence: Resolve the disputed requirement, system design, or delegation; do not choose implementation boundaries ad hoc.
gates.basis: Method activity/review requirements plus owner-assigned authority; fact names and evaluation format are governance mechanisms.

gates.title: Management acceptance before main construction
authorized_next_actions: PM may assign main construction activities against the selected project design.
gates.failure_or_missing_evidence: Return project alternatives and commitments to the Solution Architect/PM and management; do not begin main work on an unsigned option.
gates.basis: Method activity/review requirements plus owner-assigned authority; fact names and evaluation format are governance mechanisms.

gates.title: Successful service requirements review
authorized_next_actions: Proceed on bounded exploration and detailed-design branch under PM assignment.
gates.failure_or_missing_evidence: Return to service requirements; route business clarification to Product Owner and technical ambiguity to the responsible architect.
gates.basis: Method activity/review requirements plus owner-assigned authority; fact names and evaluation format are governance mechanisms.

gates.title: Admission to some construction for design insight
authorized_next_actions: Perform the explicitly bounded exploratory work and return findings to the Application Architect.
gates.failure_or_missing_evidence: Hold the experiment or refine its assignment; no unreviewed design change or phase-completion credit follows from a prototype.
gates.basis: Method activity/review requirements plus owner-assigned authority; fact names and evaluation format are governance mechanisms.

gates.title: Successful detailed-design review
authorized_next_actions: Complete the Detailed Design phase for the reviewed design.
Prepare construction handoff; construction admission also requires the accepted SDP and current PM assignment.
gates.failure_or_missing_evidence: Return to detailed design; developer proposes refinements to Application Architect; changed system bounds go to Solution Architect/CEO.
gates.basis: Method activity/review requirements plus owner-assigned authority; fact names and evaluation format are governance mechanisms.

gates.title: Admission to full construction
authorized_next_actions: Construct the assigned service and its white-box test client within the reviewed design.
gates.failure_or_missing_evidence: Hold affected full construction until missing design/assignment/commitment evidence is valid. The test-plan branch can continue independently.
gates.basis: Method activity/review requirements plus owner-assigned authority; fact names and evaluation format are governance mechanisms.

gates.title: Successful service test-plan review
authorized_next_actions: Prepare plan-based testing; execution waits for the integrated implementation.
gates.failure_or_missing_evidence: Return to the service test plan and independent review; do not weaken expectations to match a defective implementation.
gates.basis: Method activity/review requirements plus owner-assigned authority; fact names and evaluation format are governance mechanisms.

gates.title: Successful component code review
gates.failure_or_missing_evidence: Return to construction and white-box testing; escalate any required contract/design refinement before proceeding under it.
gates.basis: Method activity/review requirements plus owner-assigned authority; fact names and evaluation format are governance mechanisms.

gates.title: Technical integration acceptance
authorized_next_actions: Perform STP-based testing once its plan review also passes.
gates.failure_or_missing_evidence: Correct integration/implementation as appropriate; rerun affected review if source changes. Technical acceptance alone does not complete the Integration phase.
gates.basis: Method activity/review requirements plus owner-assigned authority; fact names and evaluation format are governance mechanisms.

gates.title: Successful testing against the service test plan
authorized_next_actions: Supply test evidence for Integration phase completion.
gates.failure_or_missing_evidence: Return failed work for correction. Reassess source, integration, plan, and dependent evidence; the three-round leadership limit is not a test-retry limit.
gates.basis: Method activity/review requirements plus owner-assigned authority; fact names and evaluation format are governance mechanisms.

gates.title: Binary phase completion and progress credit
authorized_next_actions: PM records the specific completed phase and its approved weight.
gates.failure_or_missing_evidence: Record no completion credit for an incomplete phase. Preserve historical reports; show invalidated evidence and rework in the current forecast.
gates.basis: Method activity/review requirements plus owner-assigned authority; fact names and evaluation format are governance mechanisms.

gates.title: Accepted project or system milestone
authorized_next_actions: Record the agreed milestone acceptance under the selected project plan.
gates.failure_or_missing_evidence: Resolve test, integration, or business findings through the responsible owner; do not substitute unit tests or UI demonstration for required system evidence.
gates.basis: Method activity/review requirements plus owner-assigned authority; fact names and evaluation format are governance mechanisms.

gates.title: Resume affected work after a change
authorized_next_actions: Resume only the assessed affected scope under the accepted revisions.
gates.failure_or_missing_evidence: Keep the affected scope on hold; unrelated currently authorized work may continue.
gates.basis: Method activity/review requirements plus owner-assigned authority; fact names and evaluation format are governance mechanisms.

noncoding: Use the project-designed internal tasks and explicit binary criterion appropriate to that noncoding activity; do not force every activity through service-only gates.
deployment: No listed gate independently authorizes deployment, live operation, or a new financial/trading capability.
